intent: Provide the top-of-page title, description and primary actions for a full application page.
avoid_when: heading a card or panel rather than the whole page (use card-headers)
a11y_contract: purely presentational layout; heading semantics (e.g. using an actual heading element) and action button labels remain the caller's responsibility
responsive_contract: title and actions stack vertically below the md breakpoint and become a wrapped horizontal row at md and above; the title's font size steps up at md
requires_data: a page title; optional description, breadcrumbs, tabs and action buttons
